title: Chapter 6795: Fighting Already?

Chapter 6795: Fighting Already?

Chapter 6795: Fighting Already?

The passerby influenced his life greatly, opening the door to his current achievements. However, he had no idea who the person was, not even his name.

Nevertheless, he still remembered someone addressing him as “young noble”. He didn’t recall much else since he was immersed in the sword dao.

After attaining the dao, he had tried to search for this person to no avail. Today, he appeared out of nowhere, leaving him speechless.

Although he had fought numerous battles alongside his blade, he didn’t know what to say.

“Call me young noble.” Li Qiye said.

“Young Noble.” He prostrated on the ground and said: “You gave me the sword dao, the meaning of my life, I couldn’t repay the debt...”

“No need for that, just don’t let this immortal sword down. Your talent is peerless but this type of cultivation shackles the dao, leading to inevitable qi deviation.” Li Qiye said.

“You also gave me the sword?” He was moved to tears upon hearing this: “This disciple will remember your guidance and will continue to search for the apex of the sword.”

“Leave this place, chase the sword dao with freedom.” Li Qiye said and glanced at the domain, crushing it entirely.

This unknown domain was not natural but formed from numerous immortals using their powers. They carved various sword dao into the layers, hoping to stimulate the man’s potential. Thus, he could not leave this place before reaching a certain level of mastery with the blade.

Alas, they were as feeble as spiderwebs for Li Qiye.

“Who is it?!” A figure appeared instantly, releasing a devastating immortal energy.

The saber in her embrace instantly swung for his head. However, he blocked it using his gaze alone.

The assailant was a woman with a unique and unmatched aura. She wore a plain blue robe meant for men. However, it couldn’t hide her figure with proud twin peaks, inviting others to steal glances.

Her hair was tied high and cascaded down her back like a waterfall, swaying freely in the breeze. Her eyes shone like stars; her brows were sharp like blades, radiating a heroic spirit that feared no man.

She had transcended into the immortal realm; her gender seemed to blur due to her carefree and decisive nature. However, all this was overwhelmed by a saber dao.

The moment she saw Li Qiye, she became frozen as if struck by lightning.

“You are?!” Something flashed in her mind.

“Young lady, you and I are connected by fate.” Li Qiye smiled.

“It’s you!” The moment she heard these words, memories came back instantly.

“Who else can I be?” Li Qiye joked.

“You bastard!” Her saber energy intensified.

“That’s not the proper way to greet someone, especially a friend from long ago.” Li Qiye said.

“I want to kill you.” She tried to unsheathe her saber but Li Qiye pushed the hilt, preventing her from doing so.

“You’re ruining the mood.” He smiled.

Unable to use her weapon, she delivered two slashes using her eyes.

“Clank!” They left indelible marks in space.

“Still as hot-tempered as ever.” Alas, Li Qiye tilted his head and dodged both: “Play nice now.”

An unknown force pushed her down, overwhelming her power and grand dao. She became as helpless as a mortal and could only watch the inevitable fall.

However, Li Qiye stopped her from falling.

“See, this is the consequence of being disobedient.” He shook his head.

She had never thought she would be so close to the bastard, not to mention being embraced by him. Worst of all, a supreme will dominated her.

“Boom!” Suddenly, more figures appeared and unleashed attacks against Li Qiye.

The combined blow was enough to send immortals flying, devastating this major world.
